calls.title: Growthbook <> Stage - Pricing Discussion
calls.summary: Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook sales) discussed a fixed-rate pricing proposal ($24,000/year for 10 users) to replace Ashish Pandey’s expiring Statsig startup plan, addressing his pain points around unpredictable usage-based costs and desire for a self-hosted basic experimentation and feature flagging platform. Ashish will take the proposal to his CTO and other founders, with a decision needed by the end of the week; Daniel will send the formal proposal and documentation, and they may schedule a product demo with Graham for later that week.
